capabilities: Opens .py files in a dedicated read-only view
Shows structure outline of imports, classes, functions, and constants
Filters symbols and source lines by name, kind, or text
Reports parse diagnostics such as missing colons
Caps rendering at 10,000 lines for large generated files
disambiguation: Not a Python runner, linter, or editor; it only displays .py files read-only and never executes code.
extras: Read-only by design: no execution, no writes, no network requests, no clipboard use; 10,000-line render cap with skipped-line report.
problem: Obsidian shows .py files as plain text with no symbol outline, filtering, or syntax diagnostics for quick inspection.
summary: Read-only viewer for .py files with a symbol structure outline, source view with syntax highlighting, search, and parse diagnostics.
